title.narrative: Program to Strengthen Public Policy and Fiscal Management in Response to the Health and Economic Crisis Caused by COVID-19 In Uruguay II
Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Poltica Pblica y Gestin Fiscal para la Atencin de la Crisis Sanitaria y Econmica Causada por el COVID-19 en Uruguay II

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es fortalecer la eficiencia, eficacia y equidad de la poltica pblica y la gestin fiscal para atender la crisis sanitaria y econmica causada por el COVID-19, mediante el diseo e implementacin de medidas de poltica efectivas y fiscalmente responsables. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) promover la disponibilidad y ejecucin oportuna de recursos pblicos para atender la crisis sanitaria causada por el COVID-19; (ii) fortalecer el efecto anticclico de la poltica fiscal a travs de la introduccin temporal de medidas para la proteccin del ingreso de los hogares vulnerables y para el incremento de la liquidez de las firmas durante la crisis sanitaria y econmica; (iii) apoyar la efectiva y continua provisin de bienes y servicios esenciales a travs de medidas de poltica y gestin pblica; y (iv) promover la recuperacin econmica y fiscal en el periodo post pandemia.

The general objective of the program is to strengthen the efficiency, effectiveness, and equity of public policy and fiscal management to address the health and economic crisis caused by COVID-19, through the design and implementation of effective and fiscally responsible policy measures. The specific objectives are: (i) to promote the availability and timely execution of public resources to address the health crisis caused by COVID-19; (ii) strengthen the countercyclical effect of fiscal policy through the temporary introduction of measures to protect the income of vulnerable households and to increase the liquidity of firms during the health and economic crisis; (iii) support the effective and continuous provision of essential goods and services through policy and public management measures; and (iv) promote economic and fiscal recovery in the post pandemic period.
Commitment in 2021-12-01
Disbursement in second quarter of 2023
